subject.title: Dashboard: action-form widget — buttons and forms that dispatch the agent

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a bundled dashboard action-form widget that dispatches parameterized prompts, or should this capability be routed to an external plugin/ClawHub path after the dashboard API settles?
rationale: The request adds a new operator-facing prompt-dispatch surface and depends on unsettled dashboard storage, security, and plugin-boundary choices that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Defer behind dashboard substrate review
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard substrate, storage model, and shared prompt-dispatch gate to be accepted before implementation lands.

options.title: Sponsor bundled action-form
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly approve this as first-party dashboard plugin work and require focused security and browser proof in the linked PR.

options.title: Route outward to plugin/ClawHub
options.body: If maintainers do not want bundled prompt-dispatch widgets, keep only the necessary plugin API seams in OpenClaw and ask for an external package.

recommendation.title: Defer behind dashboard substrate review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard substrate, storage model, and shared prompt-dispatch gate to be accepted before implementation lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision touches the Control UI plugin-tab precedent, plugin boundary, and security-sensitive prompt dispatch path connected to recent Logbook/plugin-tab work.
